name: Shiseido
description: Japanese beauty house founded in Ginza, Tokyo in 1872, selling premium skincare, makeup, suncare and fragrance worldwide; it recruits affiliates and creators through its own affiliate program page and network listings.

evidence.summary: Shiseido's own affiliate program page (fetched 2026-11-21) confirms the program: affiliates earn commission on purchases made through their links, with competitive rates, a 30-day cookie window, banners and a product feed, a dedicated affiliate program contact, and free signup followed by an application review. The page publishes no commission rate and no earnings-cap statement, so commission_rate is null and the cap is unknown.

WOW TRK's index of Rakuten Advertising offers lists Shiseido as a Rakuten Advertising program with region-specific offers (EMEA offer ID 47620 at 5% base commission with a 30-day cookie; Canada offer ID 52915 at 3%; Brazil at 12%), and affi.io likewise lists Shiseido on Rakuten Advertising. Because the rate is set per region with no single global rate, commission_rate is recorded null.

reasons.niche_fit: Global premium skincare and beauty house — squarely in the beauty/skincare niche with hero products creators already review.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's own program page invites site and channel owners to feature Shiseido in their content for commission; no creator cohort size is published.
reasons.compensation: Regional Rakuten offers run 3%-12% base depending on market, but no single rate is published on the official page, so commission_rate is null and the cap is unknown.
reasons.contact_access: Official affiliate program page with a dedicated affiliate contact promised and a direct application route.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program is open now — free signup with application review via the brand page and Rakuten Advertising.
reasons.credibility: One of the world's oldest and largest beauty companies, founded 1872.
